My tracking page still says DL-006 is out for delivery to my home address today. I have heard nothing from the counter. Where is it? I do not want to travel to Copperfin Counter for nothing.

Copperfin Counter scanned DL-006 into staffed stock at 14:20 UTC, but Pella Rusk's tracking page still shows it out for delivery to her home today. Please send DL-006's saved destination and full scan history. We are keeping both records side by side and making no finding until we have them.

DL-006's saved destination is Copperfin Counter, applied on 2026-02-07 at 09:41. Scan history: depot dispatch 2026-02-08 11:05, counter intake 14:20 UTC. No home route scan exists. Both records are on file. This does not show why the tracking page differs, and ready for collection is not collected.
